title: Test tier manifest
description: test-tiers.json labels every test file of one test root with one tier. The reader crux/scripts/test_tiers.py is authoritative; this schema documents the shape and a test asserts that its keys, enums and required fields equal the reader's. Rules a schema cannot state (a files key matches the root pattern, a release area is declared in areas, an override is not redundant, no duplicate JSON key) are enforced by crux/scripts/test-tiers.py check.

pattern.description: The root's non-recursive file glob, such as test*.py or *.test.ts.

areas.description: Maps an area id to a one-line description of a system area the release tier covers.

files.description: Maps a bare test file name to its entry.

area.description: Release only: an id declared in areas.

expires.description: Ephemeral only: expires or retire_when is required.

retire_when.description: Ephemeral only: expires or retire_when is required.

overrides.description: python-unittest only. Keys are ClassName or ClassName.test_method; a method override wins over a class override, which wins over the file entry.
